# Pinned reference API families

<!-- Generated by tools/reference_inventory.py --write. -->

This comparison groups related reference members under existing Python handles and formatting properties. It is not an exhaustive member inventory, implementation test, or format-conformance claim. Open XML schema/model APIs do not establish pagination or rendering. Reference products are not runtime dependencies.

Audited local surface: `52d1d9d055413a9a076eab85ae3e90d2f13144c2`. The inventory contains 44 families and 194 representative members from 17 pinned source files. Later implementation changes require review.

- [dotnet/Open-XML-SDK v3.5.1](https://github.com/dotnet/Open-XML-SDK/tree/3139fdfd27414548a41555f7848d5728f6e71a42) — `3139fdfd27414548a41555f7848d5728f6e71a42`
- [pymupdf/PyMuPDF 2.0](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/tree/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22) — `b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22`

Local dispositions describe a bounded existing subset, candidate work, recipe or remaining assessment. A family marked upstream-blocked names the specific limitation in its remaining scope; it does not imply the native library lacks all related primitives. See the separate [operation evidence matrix](support-matrix.md) for tested scopes and artifacts.

PyMuPDF core and its separate Office product already document Markdown/structured extraction and Office image rendering respectively. These are reference capabilities, not uniqueness claims for this package.

Maintain `reference-api-inventory.json`; run `python tools/reference_inventory.py` to check or add `--write` to regenerate. The optional `--source-root` checks previously downloaded source hashes and cited member lines. Offline structural checks do not independently retrieve or certify external sources.

**Criteria / owners:** API2 (W01), API3 (W01), API5 (W03), API6 (W03), DOC1 (W03), DOC2 (W03), DOC3 (W03), DOC4 (W03), DOC6 (W04), DOC8 (W03), C1 (W01), C2 (W13), C5 (W13), PKG1 (W03), PKG3 (W03)

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** Native supplied-font wrapping/strict clipping and selected font reuse limits require upstream primitives or explicit bounded rejection.

**Upstream candidates:** [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

## REF-PM-FLOW

Flowed HTML/story reports and tables.

**Reference members:** [place](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/story-class.rst#L17), [draw](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/story-class.rst#L18), [write](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/story-class.rst#L21), [fit](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/story-class.rst#L25)

**Criteria / owners:** PDF4 (W13), C4 (W13), TBL11 (W13), FORM6 (W13), API10 (W01)

**Audited local surface:** DOCX paragraph/table report recipe then native PDF conversion.

**Disposition:** `recipe_existing`. **Remaining:** Keep this a recipe using existing native layout. Do not introduce HTML/CSS or second report builder to imitate Story object hierarchy.

**Upstream candidates:** None identified in this family audit.

## REF-PM-IMAGE

Image insertion, replacement and removal.

**Reference members:** [insert_image](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L100), [replace_image](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L112), [delete_image](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L69), [get_images](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L89)

**Criteria / owners:** PDF2 (W10), MED1 (W06), MED3 (W06), BG4 (W13)

**Audited local surface:** Existing owned Office picture operations and PDF add_image use native media APIs.

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** Source PDF image replacement/removal, arbitrary alpha/blends/underlays and non-PNG authored profiles require separate native acceptance.

**Upstream candidates:** [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

## REF-PM-VECTOR

Vector paths, fills and paint ordering.

**Reference members:** [draw_line](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/shape.rst#L27), [draw_rect](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/shape.rst#L31), [draw_bezier](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/shape.rst#L24), [finish](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/shape.rst#L12), [commit](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/shape.rst#L12)

**Criteria / owners:** PDF3 (W10), MED4 (W06), BG7 (W06)

**Audited local surface:** PdfPage.draw_path; typed PPTX shape properties.

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** Native public stamping forces overlay; private prepend support must be exposed upstream. Do not wrap every draw in an adapter-built Form/layer system.

**Upstream candidates:** [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

## REF-PM-FORM-COMPOSITION

Source PDF page-as-form/background composition.

**Reference members:** [show_pdf_page](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L120)

**Criteria / owners:** PDF3 (W10), BG2 (W13), BG4 (W13), DOC6 (W04)

**Audited local surface:** No facade for arbitrary source-page Form composition.

**Disposition:** `upstream_or_unassessed`. **Remaining:** Native Form traversal silently caps4096visits/depth12; bounded aggregate decoding/UserUnit correctness and public overlay control needed.

**Upstream candidates:** [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

## REF-PM-RASTER

DPI rasterization, clipping and alpha behavior.

**Reference members:** [get_pixmap](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L92)

**Criteria / owners:** R1 (W02), R2 (W02), R3 (W02), R4 (W02), P1 (W02), P2 (W02), API9 (W13), QA4 (W14), QA7 (W14)

**Audited local surface:** render_page/get_pixmap return encoded PNG; region clip; private retained native sessions.

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** Explicit output alpha/backdrop replacement is not proven; DeckCraft can return blank fallback after panic; do not add Pixmap wrapper.

**Upstream candidates:** [U09](upstream-roadmap.md)

**Evidence profiles:** [pdf.region](support-matrix.md#pdfregion)

## REF-PM-EXTRACTION

Text geometry, links, tables and source grounding.

**Reference members:** [get_text](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L94), [get_links](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L91), [find_tables](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L83), [search_for](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L113)

**Criteria / owners:** E1 (W09), E2 (W09), E4 (W09), P4 (W02), LAY8 (W06), REF8 (W07)

**Audited local surface:** Owned normalized blocks/cells/links and source metadata; eager open plus selected extract_text.

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** Native PDF table detector is pub(crate); need bounded public detector+consumed mask. Exact automatic Office line slices/geometry remain bounded provenance gaps.

**Upstream candidates:** [U05](upstream-roadmap.md), [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

## REF-PM-MARKDOWN

Markdown, chunking and structured extraction.

**Reference members:** [to_markdown](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L143), [to_chunks](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L141), [to_json](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L142), [to_text](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L144)

**Criteria / owners:** E2 (W09), E5 (W03), E6 (W09), P4 (W02)

**Audited local surface:** to_markdown/export_markdown and normalized owned values; no RAG chunk framework.

**Disposition:** `reference_comparison`. **Remaining:** PyMuPDF2.0 already documents these APIs; packaging/licensing/Office semantic coverage can differ, not generic novelty. Chunk metadata is reference-only.

**Upstream candidates:** None identified in this family audit.

## REF-PM-NAVIGATION

Links, outlines, metadata and page labels.

**Reference members:** [get_toc](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L86), [set_toc](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L137), [set_metadata](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L130), [set_page_labels](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L133)

**Criteria / owners:** PDF5 (W10), DOC7 (W03), REF1 (W07), REF2 (W07), REF8 (W07)

**Audited local surface:** Owned bookmarks/links/metadata and preserved imported labels; no combined reference engine.

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** Current named-destination/outline depth limits and unsupported document properties need explicit profiles; broader page label authoring is separate acceptance.

**Upstream candidates:** [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

## REF-PM-ANNOTATIONS

Annotation operations and appearances.

**Reference members:** [update](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/annot.rst#L41), [set_colors](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/annot.rst#L30), [set_opacity](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/annot.rst#L35), [set_border](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/annot.rst#L28)

**Criteria / owners:** PDF6 (W10), REV1 (W07), REV6 (W13)

**Audited local surface:** Owned note/highlight/link/markup annotation subset and typed properties.

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** Do not call PDF annotations equivalent to tracked DOCX review. Broader appearances/quads/replies/rotation require native fixtures.

**Upstream candidates:** [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

## REF-PM-FORMS

Interactive widgets and field values.

**Reference members:** [field_name](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/widget.rst#L92), [field_value](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/widget.rst#L104), [field_type](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/widget.rst#L114), [rect](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/widget.rst#L134), [choice_values](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/widget.rst#L88), [update](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/widget.rst#L58)

**Criteria / owners:** PDF6 (W10), FORM3 (W08), PKG5 (W03)

**Audited local surface:** PdfFields/PdfField owned text/checkbox/choice profile with geometry/value updates.

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** Imported enumeration silently truncates/loses widgets/unknown kinds; require public fallible bounded inventory before safe general source-form editing. Script/signature behavior is excluded.

**Upstream candidates:** [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

**Evidence profiles:** [pdf.owned-fields](support-matrix.md#pdfowned-fields)

## REF-PM-REDACTION

Redaction markers versus irreversible content removal.

**Reference members:** [add_redact_annot](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L54), [apply_redactions](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L64)

**Criteria / owners:** PDF7 (W10), REV6 (W13)

**Audited local surface:** No secure redaction runtime API promised.

**Disposition:** `upstream_blocked`. **Remaining:** Native vertical writing unsupported; vector/shading residual semantics and aggregate bounds insufficient. Overlay rectangles never substitute for removal.

**Upstream candidates:** [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

**Evidence profiles:** [pdf.vertical-redaction](support-matrix.md#pdfvertical-redaction)

## REF-PM-OUTPUT-PROFILES

Cleanup, encryption, incremental save and embedded files.

**Reference members:** [scrub](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L124), [saveIncr](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L123), [can_save_incrementally](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L53), [embfile_add](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L61), [embfile_get](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L64)

**Criteria / owners:** PDF8 (W10), PKG1 (W03), PKG2 (W03), PKG5 (W03), PKG6 (W03), PKG7 (W03), PKG8 (W03), REV6 (W13)

**Audited local surface:** Conservative PDF edit/save rejects unsupported preservation profiles.

**Disposition:** `upstream_or_unassessed`. **Remaining:** Attachment API fixed1GiB decode limit and no suitable bounded writer; arbitrary encryption/active-content/PDF-A/UA profiles unassessed. No raw PDF object escape hatch.

**Upstream candidates:** [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

## REF-PM-OFFICE

Separate Office product reference.

**Reference members:** [get_pixmap](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/pymupdf-office/index.rst#L170)

**Criteria / owners:** R1 (W02), R2 (W02), C2 (W13), E1 (W09), E3 (W09), SLIDE1 (W11)

**Audited local surface:** Existing Office render/extract uses permissive pinned native crates without runtime license service.

**Disposition:** `reference_comparison`. **Remaining:** Office reference is separate commercial product; it already renders Office pages. This does not establish an editable DOCX authoring API or market uniqueness.

**Upstream candidates:** None identified in this family audit.
